channel.title: The Albert Lea Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Tigers close out final day at state tourney
item.description: Four Albert Lea wrestlers started the final day of the state tournament still with hopes of climbing as high as third place in their respective weight classes.

item.title: Building a place where every student can grow
item.description: When Dave Langerud came from St. Cloud three years ago to take on the position of activities director for the Albert Lea school district, his goal was to change the culture that he found here.

item.title: New G-E superintendent takes on two roles at school
item.description: GLENVILLE — Setting goals — and reaching them — has been a part of Heidi Venem’s entire career in education.

item.title: Albert Lea cross country coaching legends step down
item.description: Albert Lea’s well known cross country coaching duo retired as coaches at the end of the fall season — but not after impacting hundreds of students as a coach and likely thousands more as teachers in their time with the district.

item.title: Bridging the music gap: Alden-Conger band teacher organizes and leads multi-generational community jazz band
item.description: As a musician and educator, Ben Jahnke understands the positive influence music can have on a person’s life. It is something he gets to experience both in the classroom and in his new role as the director of Freeborn Jazz Band.

item.title: Providing an option for home births: Midwife opens practice, providing care in a ‘maternity care desert’
item.description: WELLS — With many rural health care providers pulling, scaling back or changing their labor and delivery services, expectant mothers and their families are left with questions about what their options are as they welcome their babies into the world.

item.title: Schlaak takes fourth at state tournament, other area wrestlers compete
item.description: Three wrestlers from NRHEG and one from Maple River/United South Central took to St. Paul over the weekend, competing in the Class A and AA state wrestling tournament.

item.title: 70 years of playing the church organ: Woman plans to continue as long as she can in the role
item.description: At a recent church personnel meeting, organ player Gail Thurnau shared that she had just bought two new pairs of organ shoes — footwear with soft leather soles designed to slide easily on organ pedals.

item.title: Emmons Lutheran Church going strong even in the absence of a pastor
item.description: Usually when a pastor leaves a congregation for another call, the congregation uses pulpit supply pastors to fill in until a new pastor accepts a call to their church.

item.title: Woman opens thermography business at Skyline Plaza
item.description: Jill Vandenheuvel will be the first to tell you she feels God led her to her new business venture.
